Operational Risks & Bottlenecks

  • Delayed Implementations: Cohorts in later shifts experienced tight schedules during Day 2 simulations. Ensure 45-minute reserved arcade slots in class schedules.
  • Pending Survey Feedback: Trainees completing assessments often miss submitting the end-of-course survey unless prompted on Day 3 graduation.
  • Low Adoption Accounts: Smaller pilot accounts require dedicated trainer briefing to reinforce the mandatory nature of soft skills certification.

Leadership & Next Operational Actions

  • Immediate Priority: Mandate Day 3 soft skills survey completion prior to final class sign-off across all Cairo sites.
  • Upcoming Milestone: Roll out Culture & Empathy simulations across remaining non-voice client accounts by next month.
  • Leadership Action: Calibrate trainers showing over 15% quiz variance to standardize practical soft skill delivery.
Executive Calculation & Business Impact Logic Configuration
Customizable Financial & Productivity Formulas

Customize financial assumptions, hourly cost rates, productivity gains, and qualifying rules used across the Executive Summary and Business Impact meters.

Active Calculation Reference:

• Optimized Agents: Headcount matching selected condition.
• Total Optimized Hours: Optimized Agents × Hours Saved / Agent
• Business Savings (EGP): Total Hours × Hourly Rate (EGP) × (1 + Lift %)
• Annual Savings (EUR): (Business Savings ÷ EUR Rate) × Annual Multiplier
Adjusting formulas immediately updates KPI cards & Business Impact values above.
How it is calculated

Agents with assessment in section ÷ hired agents

189 ÷ 2,034 hired = 9.3%
189 ÷ 317 participated = 59.6%
